issues: Single small quest panel floats mid-sky (centre, 40-57% height) with nodes spilling out of it and a big dark octagon/diamond lines over the mountain; panel does not feel part of the scene
Scene is empty in the upper 25% (sky only) and left 30% of the middle; props (stump with book, pouch, axe, sign) are tiny and scattered
Pixel density of clouds/mountains is coarser than the cabin and props; hard 1-px dither stripes in sky read as banding
Nodes at far right (dark gear) and bottom diamonds have low contrast against the purple mountain
scores.what_for_8: Anchor the node cluster to the scene (e.g. a notice board or sign) and keep every node inside the panel; fill the left/mid-ground with a few more intentional props; unify pixel density between background and props.

issues: Right 60% of the middle band (heartbeat monitor, first-aid sign) is a bit sparse and the heartbeat panel floats near the section 2 panel (right-centre, 43%)
Section 3 and 4 panels have small dim nodes with slightly low-contrast dark icons (centre, 58-62%)
Hanging herbs and rail at top are slightly thin, window competes with title for focal point
Pink panel borders fine but title banner icons a bit small
scores.what_for_8: Already near 8.5: tighten empty gaps beside the panels and brighten the dark node icons in sections 3 and 4.

issues: Panels are scattered over the sky with uneven spacing and a long diagonal connector line from panel 3 to panel 6 crossing the gap (centre, 40-65%)
Section 5 panel overlaps the sunset/tree area and its semi-transparent fill is muddy over the glow (left, 60-78%)
Large empty dusk sky centre-right (right 30-55%) and bottom-centre field rows are repetitive wheat stripes with a coarser pixel look than the barn
Many nodes are dark diamonds/hearts blending into the dark panel fill
scores.what_for_8: Rebalance panel layout into a clearer grid, make panel fills opaque enough over the sunset, reduce long connector crossings and add midground interest in the right-sky void.

issues: Panels sit on a busy dithered forest/mountain band; panel fills are translucent and the dark node discs lose contrast (centre, 25-75%)
Left ore stair cliff and right furnace are heavy and nearly same value, the centre bottom forge is small and the middle is a murky dark-red mass (bottom-centre 50-75%)
Sun glow top-right competes with section 3 panel; section 3 lines are crowded fan-out at its right edge
Section 1 to 2 and 2 to 3 connectors run between panels with thin low-contrast lines
scores.what_for_8: Raise panel contrast or give them a solid backing, simplify the muddy forest band, and give the central forge more presence to create a clearer focal point.

issues: Panels sit mostly on glowing sunset sky with brown fills; header text over bright sun area is readable but node icons are small (centre, 30-65%)
Section 5 panel holds a single dark gear node and section 4 two nodes, feels thin/empty (centre-right 55-65%)
Mountains behind panels are busy jagged pixel triangles with stripe dither; sun glow smudge at 48% centre looks like a dark blotch
Bottom row of ingots and rubble at corners is a bit sticker-like
scores.what_for_8: Fix the dark smudge near section 1/2 panels, merge or enlarge sparse sections, and soften the sticker-like ingot props; otherwise coherent and warm.

issues: Panels are olive/gold on dark; node icons are tiny, dark hexagons and squares have low contrast inside panels (centre, 25-75%)
Section 2 has sparse disconnected nodes, section 3 wide panel is half empty (centre 42-57%)
Left and right towers are strong but rather symmetrical and heavy; middle ground between panels and pumpjack is murky
Banner olive-green glow is a slight colour clash with the orange sunset
scores.what_for_8: Brighten node icon contrast, tighten sparse section panels, and tint the banner to match the orange/steel palette.

systemic: Translucent dark panel fills over busy or glowing backgrounds give inconsistent node contrast; many dark placeholder-shaped nodes (diamond, hexagon, circle) vanish
Panel layouts leave awkward empty or half-filled sections while scenes have uneven pixel density between backgrounds (coarse dithered) and props (finer)
Banner icons are small; section headers readable but node icons at ~29 px are tiny
Scenes are strong thematically and cohesive in pixel style; the weak point is integration of UI panels with the art
ceiling_estimate: Roughly 8.0-8.5 with panel/contrast integration fixes; 9 would need hand-tuned depth and lighting integrated with the node layout.
